beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When your work folder can't be reached (for example, Google Drive hasn't loaded yet), Work Sample Buddy shows one clear screen: your records are safe on this computer, which folder can't be reached, and your choices. It rechecks automatically, recommends a restart if the folder stays missing, and never treats the situation as a new install.
• Choosing a different folder while your usual one is offline now checks whether your existing files are really there, asks before saving new work elsewhere, and offers to switch back once the usual folder returns.

Fixes:
• The saved work folder is no longer forgotten after clicking Continue Without Files during a Google Drive outage, which made the next launch look like a first-time setup and recommended an unrelated folder.
• Removed the misplaced Sync Pathways button from the student matrix. Roster syncing remains available in the Connections menu.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
